meta.name: add-webex
meta.description: Add Webex channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在应用中集成Webex聊天频道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在应用里接入Webex聊天功能。
copy.tagline_en: Integrate Webex chat into your app.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add Webex chat to your app.

howto.what: 启用后，Claude 会从 channels 分支复制 Webex 适配器与测试到项目，注册适配器，安装依赖，执行构建和集成测试，接着引导你配置 Webex 机器人与 webhook 凭据。
howto.when: 当你说需要添加 Webex 渠道、接入 Chat SDK，或为项目启用 Webex 支持时触发。

say.text: 把 Webex 渠道加到项目里
say.note: Claude 会复制适配器、注册并安装依赖，然后构建测试。

say.text: 帮我加 Webex 并提示我配置机器人凭据
say.note: 自动步骤后，会引导你完成机器人和 webhook 设置。

say.text: 设置 Webex 凭据并写入 .env

howto.what_en: When enabled, Claude copies the Webex adapter and its test from the channels branch into the project, registers the adapter, installs the dependency, builds, and runs the integration test. It then guides you through configuring a Webex bot and webhook credentials.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add the Webex channel, integrate with Chat SDK, or enable Webex support for the project.

say_en.text: Add the Webex channel to the project.
Add Webex and prompt me for bot credentials.
say_en.note: After automatic steps, it asks for the bot token and webhook secret.
Claude prompts for the two secrets and writes them.
